title: Dual-mode Staging ingress and Custom GPT MCP bootstrap

phases.objective: Make local Windows/Docker Staging ingress mode explicit, preserve both Windows Service and Docker sidecar tunnel deployments, centralize ignored .env.staging generation, bind Admin/Tenant Custom GPT and Remote MCP public readiness to fail-closed remote probes, and provide governed Staging-only MCP OAuth client identity/secret provisioning without persisting user access or refresh tokens.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The selected Staging tunnel runtime is mutually exclusive and mode-correct, public HTTPS and Admin/Tenant Custom GPT schemas/auth metadata are remotely reachable, Remote MCP metadata/schema are reachable, optional MCP App provisioning runs inside the Staging app container with secret-free readback, and PLATFORM_READY cannot be emitted when public ingress is unavailable.
steps: Generate missing local-only Staging secrets once through Staging-Environment.ps1 while preserving existing non-placeholder values.

Generate a Staging-prefixed Remote MCP App ID, confidential App Secret, isolated OAuth signing secret, Tenant GPT OAuth secrets, and database/runtime secrets into ignored .env.staging without committing values.
Reject persisted Remote MCP authorization codes, access tokens, or refresh tokens; user tokens are minted only by the runtime OAuth authorization-code flow.
Select windows_service, docker_sidecar, or disabled explicitly and stop the opposite tunnel runtime before activation.

For windows_service publish app only on 127.0.0.1:8080 and require Cloudflared Windows Service to use --token-file; for docker_sidecar preserve internal app:8080 DNS and require the ignored Staging tunnel token.
Run the existing exact-SHA local bootstrap and re-assert the selected canonical tunnel mode before public certification.
Fetch Tenant/Admin Staging OpenAPI schemas, Tenant OAuth metadata, Remote MCP authorization/protected-resource metadata, and bounded authentication enforcement over public HTTPS.
Perform a bounded authenticated Admin GPT read-only probe with the Staging backend key.
When explicitly requested, provision the openai_chatgpt Remote MCP client inside the app container using the generated App ID/App Secret and require secret-redacted status readback.
Block platform readiness if the selected public ingress, Custom GPT, OAuth, or Remote MCP gates do not pass.
assertions: windows_service and docker_sidecar are first-class mutually exclusive modes; disabled remains available for local-only Staging.
Windows Service origin is http://127.0.0.1:8080 with loopback-only host publication; Docker sidecar origin remains http://app:8080 without host publication requirement.
Windows Service never consumes an inline --token argument and requires --token-file; only Docker sidecar requires CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN in ignored .env.staging.
Staging-Environment.ps1 is the canonical source of newly generated .env.staging values and does not implicitly rotate populated values.
REMOTE_MCP_APP_ID uses the mcp_stg_ namespace and REMOTE_MCP_APP_SECRET is at least 32 characters of cryptographically random material.
REMOTE_MCP_OAUTH_SIGNING_SECRET remains isolated from JWT_SECRET and MCP user authorization/access/refresh tokens are not persisted in .env.staging.
MCP client provisioning requires the explicit PROVISION_REMOTE_MCP_STAGING confirmation and executes against the Staging Runtime DB from inside the app container.
Canonical App Secret provisioning output is redacted and status/readback remains secrets_included=false.
Admin/Tenant Staging schema URLs and MCP resource URLs remain on dev.mad4b.com, activation-dev.mad4b.com, and mcp_dev.mad4b.com only.
Public ingress failure blocks platform_ready when a tunnel mode is selected.
No Production deployment, Production database mutation, Hostinger mutation, Cloudflare DNS mutation, provider mutation, or production_live authority is granted.

phases.objective: Review shared Remote MCP provisioning compatibility without granting Production activation or mutation authority.
blockers: Production remains outside this pull request and requires a separate governed promotion lifecycle.
The shared provisioner explicitly refuses Staging REMOTE_MCP_APP_ID/REMOTE_MCP_APP_SECRET variables when environment=production.
No Production, Hostinger, Cloudflare, provider, production database, or deployment mutation is authorized by this declaration.
